verdict.rationale: GitLab claims to apply compliance controls and collect audit evidence in every pipeline, and to run SAST, DAST, and compliance in every pipeline (gitlab-docs-20, gitlab-docs-50). The REST API supports managing CI/CD across multiple projects and keeping permissions consistent organization-wide (gitlab-docs-13, gitlab-docs-14). However, the evidence is marketing-level, and coding-standards enforcement relies mostly on third-party partners like Semgrep and CodeAnt, or on Agent Platform customization. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on org-wide policy mechanisms (e.g., enforced pipeline or approval policies, compliance frameworks applied across groups), native coding-standards enforcement across all repositories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
